newsitem.title: USA: Southern Ill. University to sell bonds -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Southern Ill. University to sell bonds -- paper.

text.p: Southern Illinois University trustees have approved the sale of $31 million of revenue bonds for student housing at the campus near the southern tip of the state, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported Friday.
About $16.4 million of the proceeds would finance a second dormitory for the university and another $13.7 million would go to renovating a deteriorating apartment building, the newspaper said.
Proceeds would also fund two smaller projects, the newspaper reported.
The revenue bonds will be backed by student housing revenues, student activity fees, usage fees and interest earnings, the newspaper said.
